wiki.title: Kevin Hern
wiki.extract: Kevin Ray Hern (born December 4, 1961) is an American politician and businessman who is a United States senator-elect from Oklahoma. A member of the Republican Party, he has represented Oklahoma's 1st congressional district in the United States House of Representatives since 2018.
